description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the Aws\S3\UseArnRegion namespace. It provides various static methods for creating configuration providers that determine AWS S3 'Use ARN Region' settings based on environment variables, configuration files, or default values. The class facilitates chaining multiple providers and caching configurations, which are used to customize AWS SDK behavior related to S3 region configuration when using ARNs.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: A static class providing methods to generate configuration providers for AWS S3 'Use ARN Region' settings, including environment-based, INI file-based, fallback, chaining, and caching providers.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider chain that checks environment variables, config files, and falls back to default settings. Supports optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a provider that obtains the configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a provider that loads configuration from a specified INI configuration file for a given profile.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides default fallback configuration when other sources are absent.
